errors.evidence: The bars are sorted in ascending order of value from top to bottom (from 84% to approximately 93%), not in descending order.
The longest bar, corresponding to the bottom category, reaches approximately 93% on the x-axis, not 94%. The bar clearly ends halfway between the 92% and 94% tick marks.
